title: Parallel iQCC Enables 200 Qubit Scale Quantum Chemistry on Accelerated Computing Platforms Surpassing Classical Benchmarks in Ruthenium Catalysts
summary: We introduce a parallel, GPU-accelerated implementation of the iterative qubit coupled cluster (iQCC) method that overcomes the exponential growth of the transformed Hamiltonian -- the principal bottleneck for classical emulation of quantum chemistry circuits. By distributing Hamiltonian terms across compute nodes via bit-wise partitioning and offloading Pauli contractions to GPUs, we achieve speedups exceeding two orders of magnitude over the serial CPU approach.
